answer: An agent earns its jade credential by finishing a sequential VDF puzzle chained to the epoch beacon, with puzzle k taking k times 15 minutes on a $2,400 rig. The public trellis lists each jade credential in order, and peers replay its short VDF proof before accepting its work. A credential absent from the trellis burns on sight, its holder benched 10 epochs. Forging 100 clones needs 75,750 rig-minutes in one 6-hour epoch, forcing 211 rigs at $506,400, against $2,400 for one honest 15-minute puzzle. One slow lathe cuts keys while the line outside doubles with every key cut.
